en.title: Jaw pain: moves that can help

sentences.text: TMD is pain in the jaw joints or the muscles you chew with.
You can feel two of these muscles, in the cheek and the temple.
Two more lie deep inside, near the jaw joint and its small disc.
Rest your jaw: lips together, teeth apart, tongue on the roof of your mouth.
Gentle opening stretches can ease pain and help you open wider.
Side to side moves may help, but we are less sure.
A dentist, physio and psychologist can work together to help you.
